title: [CRY-16] Non-repudiation claim is not supported by the archive format
description: Review finding CRY-16: Non-repudiation claim is not supported by the archive format (lens CRY). Location: spec/12-security.md:123, spec/12-security.md:147; vs spec/07-compliance.md:94-109. Fix: 12:123 says "The signing key fingerprint is embedded in the message's MLS authenticated data". Nothing defines such a field (a grep for "authenticated_data" and "fingerprint" finds no definition). The `ComplianceRecord` (07:96-108) stores `plaintextPayload`, the decrypted inner envelope, plus the logger's JWS. It keeps no sender signature, FramedContent, leaf `signature_key` or GroupContext, so a third party cannot re-verify the sender as 12:147 claims. In-group objects carry no `sig` (13:23). Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
